title: Measure checked tiling summaries on identical callers
description: Measure inlining and a checked recursive helper lemma at identical bounds and budgets on the exact and parity consumers. Measure the independent exact-cache control cold and warm, then change only the helper base case and check both consumers again.
expected: Recorded artifact hashes, costs, non-vacuity or first blocker and cache origin for each caller, strategy, and logical cache condition.
